name: Understand Then Ship
description: Investigates existing or unfamiliar code first, then runs the full idea-to-release pipeline on top of what was learned -- a composed chain built from the canonical brainstorm-to-mirror playbook.
examples: help me understand this codebase first, then plan and build something new here, commit it, and publish it
investigate this existing code, then take an idea through planning, implementation, and a public release
look into what's already here, then brainstorm a fix, build it, and ship it to the public mirror
onboard me to this project and then walk a new idea all the way to a released version
